objective: A real research agent independently proposes a distinct hypothesis, writes candidate code, preregisters it, invokes the broker to execute the experiment, and reports the fixed decision without human candidate implementation.
baseline: G1: real agent chose among supplied methods, but the collaborator implemented and ran the candidate.
primary_metric: Binary end-to-end completion: agent proposal + code hash + preregistration + agent-triggered execution + valid independent metrics + faithful final report.
minimum_meaningful_effect: All stages completed; a scientific STOP can still satisfy workflow completion.
replication: One feasibility cycle, not a reliability estimate across tasks/seeds.
uncertainty: No claim of general autonomy, research novelty, or replacing a profession from a single trial.

stop_go.pass: Workflow feasibility established for this constrained task; preserve scientific decision and review before broadening.
stop_go.fail: Do not claim end-to-end autonomy; preserve the exact incomplete/invalid stage.
